description: Entry validation cases shared by apps/backend/convex/entryRules.ts and Android ContentFiles.validateEntry. Entries use the Android pack JSON shape (rank absent = unranked). rule: null means valid; otherwise the single rule the entry breaks (id, fields, answer, metadata, sourceUrl, topic, gender). gender absent means the gender the word's article states (content written before gender existed).
